title: Mountain long run, 2h30 / ~900m D+
terrain: Colli Berici from Brendola, ~900m D+ as 3-4 climbs of 200-300m (repeat the longest one if needed), at least one descent of 250m+ run at race effort

steps.target: Z3-Z4, 160-168bpm, last climb at race effort

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 2h30, ~900m D+. Bulk at 145-155bpm, hike anything steep. Last climb 20min at 160-168bpm (race effort), then run the descent off it at race effort, 172+ spm, quick light steps.
BENCHMARK: Strava segment 'Californication UP' (949m, +67m, ~7%). 18 Jul 2026: 7:39 at avg 168bpm, ~55min into an 18.9km long run (Silver PR). Route Saturday so it falls inside the last-climb block at 1h50+. Run it at 160-168bpm, no harder. Read: under 7:39 at the same or lower HR = clear aerobic gain since July; same time at lower HR = gain; slower at 168 = fatigue, not fitness loss. Optional second marker: 'full throttle monte comunale' (434m, +57m, 13%), 4:59 at 170bpm in July, hike-run, same HR cap.
GYM: none. Route: stack the longest Berici climbs; if a loop is short on vert, repeat the best climb rather than adding flat.
FUEL: dinner Fri by 20:30, light, no alcohol. 2 flasks Tailwind (500ml, 2 scoops each) from min 20, Carbo Gels at 1h15 and 2h00 (~70g/h).
GARMIN: ~200-230.
STOP RULE: HRV under 60 or RHR over 51, skip the race-effort block and cap at 2h. Any knee pain on a descent: walk the remaining descents, finish on the climbs.
WHY: first race-volume vertical since Pirin; VWT is 914m D+, so the long run now matches the race.
